summary.text: Matt Koch is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 72 who has served since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Marine Corps veteran, he works as a horse farmer.

paragraphs.text: Matt Koch was born in Paris, Kentucky, served in the United States Marine Corps, reaching the rank of captain, and earned a degree from the University of Kentucky College of Agriculture.
His career experience includes working as a horse farmer, and he has been a member of the Bourbon County Agriculture Extension Council and the Kentucky Thoroughbred Association Board.
Koch took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2019, succeeding Sannie Overly.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Agriculture Committee and the Elections, Constitutional Amendments and Intergovernmental Affairs Committee, and he chairs the Licensing, Occupations, and Administrative Regulations Committee.
